title: RouteWeaver: Weaving Mode Selection and Execution into Unified LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.19705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM routing dynamically selects and coordinates heterogeneous language models across diverse tasks. However, existing approaches are largely built around a predefined execution paradigm, such as single-round, multi-round, or agentic routing, which fixes how model calls are organized and limits adaptation to different query needs. We propose RouteWeaver, a unified routing framework that integrates these routing modes within a single LLM policy, jointly learning which mode to use and how to select models within that mode. To jointly optimize mode selection and within-mode execution, we develop COMET-GRPO (COordinated Mode-Execution Training), which decouples the trajectory-level advantage into separate signals for mode selection and within-mode execution, enabling more targeted credit assignment to each decision level. We further introduce progressive exploration, which gradually shifts training from externally assigned modes to autonomous

translated_title: RouteWeaver：将模式选择与执行编织为统一的大语言模型路由
translated_abstract: 大语言模型路由（LLM routing）能够在多种任务中动态选择并协调异构的语言模型。然而，现有方法大多围绕某种预定义的执行范式构建，例如单轮、多轮或智能体（agentic）路由，这固定了模型调用的组织方式，限制了对不同查询需求的适应性。我们提出 RouteWeaver，一个统一的路由框架，它将这些路由模式整合到单个大语言模型策略之中，联合学习应使用哪种模式以及在该模式下如何选择模型。为了对模式选择与模式内执行进行联合优化，我们开发了 COMET-GRPO（协调式模式-执行训练，COordinated Mode-Execution Training），该方法将轨迹级优势函数解耦为分别对应模式选择与模式内执行的两路独立信号，从而实现对各决策层级更有针对性的信用分配。我们进一步引入渐进式探索机制，使训练从外部指派的模式逐渐过渡到自主选择的模式。
tldr: 提出 RouteWeaver 统一路由框架，在单个 LLM 策略中联合学习路由模式选择（单轮/多轮/智能体）与模式内模型执行，并通过 COMET-GRPO 将优势信号解耦到两个决策层级以实现更精准的信用分配与联合优化。
en_tdlr: RouteWeaver is a unified LLM routing framework that jointly learns routing-mode selection (single-round, multi-round, agentic) and within-mode model execution, with COMET-GRPO decoupling trajectory-level advantages into separate signals for targeted credit assignment at both decision levels.
